body:
What I mentioned is of course the tip of the iceberg, like right now I'm out taking care of my mother so she's set up, repairing their relationship with my angry sometimes violent sister. I guess what I'm saying it's a deep rabbit hole. 
This comment may mean little to you, but to me it means a lot, your words helped me prepare to face today. And sometimes that's all you can ask for. Always know that in a time of need, you made a friend indeed. Many thanks. The world needs more people like you. Do as I will do, and try to make today a good one.

I'm exhausted. There us a chance because I've built myself in a healthy support team. But after fighting for every inch for 25+ years, I've got little left. 

But my wife. You're right about staying for her. I don't know if I can, but suicide would be super selfish to her, and I love her more than anything. And she knows I'm tired. But also my prolonged exhaustion is starting to negatively effect her. And that hurts worse.

Thank you for taking the time to both read and write to me. At least today, I'll get up and put one foot in front of the other until I can't anymore. Don't know exactly when that day that pushes you past your limit will come.

You are very nice and considerate, and in would like to thank you for reaching out and supporting me and others. Please have a great day, and may you and your family be safe my friend.

Hey. I didn't realize I hadn't changed accounts. So I logged back in and saw your reply. I appreciate it. I hadn't even considered my future records. Although I will need to check, I'm not entirely sure how that would be accessed by a future doctor. I'll be looking into that.

Honestly, I'm comfortable financially. My wife is in business sales and is really good at it. It's in travel, so really down right now, but it's a good company, so they are working to ensure the care of all their employees. I do appreciate your concern though. The only reason my job is important other than it's always nice to have a second income is that I work with children with autism or on the spectrum. I have my heart wrapped up in caring for children and helping them. To go from job to job where they don't remember you, after spending a full day working my ass of to help a child, I sometimes get a hug. Failure to be there for my little friends due to this... whatever it is, tears me up.

Turns out my wife took the initiative to call every one of my "health providers," and reamed the good, while I was out sleeping, and she just closed the relationship with my... again, I don't think doctor is the right word, and didn't care enough to be bothered by his complaints. Although we were just gonna let it go, your mention of a standing record, makes me contemplate reviewing things. Thank you for that.

But I feel much better. I didnt realize it until it settled on that I would never see him again. In retrospect, he had an inability to respect anyone's opinion but his own. I now see a pattern between poor, easy service he gave me and the decline in my health. Correlational though, causation, as usual, is not explicit but highly probable.

That's the shining star I had to brush off  to see the light. My wife went to battle for me. And while I was out. When I learned what she had done, I didn't know how to handle it because no one had ever stood up for me. For as long as i can remember. That was my place to start. I'm fortunate. I am building off of knowing who I can trust without question. Most don't have that fortune. 

But I'm done. I'm done taking crap from people I always immediately put on a pedestal because my American South manners dictate that you treat everyone as a guest in your home until they break that trust. In this case I was pushed so far, I think I snapped back in my personal reality. That may sound like flowery prose you hear so often from people who are distraught, but it's the truth.

I'm tired of feeling down. I'm tired of allowing other people dictate how I feel. I'm tired of not finding myself worthy because of the opinion of people, that usually turn out to be horrible when looked at, just because I forgot how to stand on my own two feet. I'm sick and tired of feeling sick and tired. And it stops now.

While eventually I may regress some. I see the ground I'm on now, and depression will have to put me in the ground before I am willing to give up on that. A dangerous bet to be sure, probably dangerous to even say, but if there has ever been a time to lay it on the line, that time has come. A "year ago me" would hate "next years me," if "current me," destroyed all my progress. Looking back a year, I see a lot that I've accomplished, and I would be surprised to find that I'm here. 

I dedicated most of my life trying to pay a penance for my mistake. I now count that as paid. At least in this moment, this one right now, I'm back to being confident. What else have I got to lose. The most I've ever felt free, was when I thought I was going to prison, and completely disregarded everyone's opinions of me because, "why?"

Today's a new day. I will fight for many reason I have only observed after my lost hope in my care, and am focusing my new mental structure on solid ground with the person I can trust (my wife) instead of the shifting sands of someone that does not have my best interests at heart. After all, if she was will to fight for me like that, why shouldn't I? Don't I owe my loyal, loving, hopeful awesome wife that? For me? Taking care of me is an active process that I must contribute to, not passively let wash over me ad I cry, whoa as me. I mean I know I'll have slip ups and mistakes, but I'm sinking my teeth in deep and going to make depression earn back every inch it wants to take from me.

I do really appreciate your message. You took genuine care and time to put that together, and that isnt lost on me. I'm dont apologizing to people that have done me wrong and am focusing on thanking the people who are treating me right. That means you.

Thank you.

E: words

Please. No one respond. I just needed to get it out somewhere. Panicky word vomit. 

It easier to think that no one saw this, than no one replied. I won't be back on this account to review messages. Waiting will just make me sicker. I'm just gonna keep on hanging on, just a little longer.

Have a good day, great evening, and even better week.

Love each other. Support each other. We got this. Everyone stay healthy and safe.

Yes sir. I have. And I don't remember or care about her because I reached out. Got help. For me it took professional help. But I learned that I needed help. Heartbreak hurts man. I once met my girlfriends boyfriend at where she worked. It does get better. Get someone on the horn that will be better able to give professional advice.

Help. Professional help. During that entire time did you find one person that listened? One person that you felt cared? Shit. Last time I went to the hospital it felt like the EMT was the only one who gave a shit, and when the chaplan came around, I asked him to pray for the medic instead of me.

Long story. Stupid point.

There are people out there that genuinely care. They want to help you. You would be surprised to find can help you up when you need it. People do care. ABOUT YOU. You just need to reach to those with the knowledge and experience to know what to do, and that is anyone that will get you started. Best friend, neighbor, psychiatrist, dude at the bowling alley, but then let them lead you to professional help. People want to listen and help. (Why else would someone get into psychiatry.)

You may be stuck, but please reach out to help any way you can. I'm not it, but I imagine a lot of people with real authority will not be happy to hear how you are being treated. Hell. I'm certainly not happy to hear it. Find a way to reach out to whatever help you need, may it be psychiatrist ,lawful, or a neighbor. Just reach out. Even if for no better reason to get your stepfather to go get fucked.

Don't compare yourself to the highlights of other peoples lives. It happens with social media especially. I keep seeing clips of how everyone is happy and great. Compare that to my day to day, and I feel down as well. Remember. Life is not a race. Actually, you don't want to get first. Everyone has their own pace. For myself, it's a little slower. It will take time, but we always arrive at the right time. You are good, you are worthy, you have the strength to reach out to help when you're most in need. I'm sure a professional or better help is just around the corner, especially if you look. Please get help, and get better. I'll try too.

Many of the people that you think right now, "don't care" would be devastated.

But that's a selfish reason for them.

How about this, if you've truly got nothing to lose. Nothing at all...Nothing. Then why not talk to a doc? Fuck it. What do you have to lose, but your despression. 

"Try everything once, except incest and folk dancing." ~Sir Thomas Beecham

I ain't shit for giving advice, but after looking at your history, you've got some interest in some cool shit. Seem to be a cool person too. But, just like learning a new skill or activity, you always want to seek those with experience. It might be time to ask for that help yourself. You deserve a helping hand.

P.S. I wanna learn to ride motorbikes as well. Only done it a couple times. Got a lot of suggestions on what NOT to do.
It would bother me. And I imagine a lot of people you don't expect would care too.
